topic: Solution Concentration: Percent by Volume and Mass
key_concepts: Solutions consist of a solute and a solvent.
Solute is the component in smaller amount; solvent is the dissolving medium in greater qua
Concentration can be expressed qualitatively or quantitatively.
Percent by volume is the volume of solute present in 100 mL of solution.
Percent by volume equals volume of solute divided by total volume of solution times 100.
Percent by mass is the grams of solute per 100 grams of solution.
Percent by mass equals mass of solute divided by mass of solution times 100.
Mass of solution equals mass of solute plus mass of solvent.
Volumes and masses must be expressed in the same units when computing percent concentratio
Product labels often show concentration as percent by volume or mass.
A 12.5% ethanol wine sample contains 37.5 mL ethanol in 300 mL solution.
A 21.2% salt solution contains 5.30 g salt dissolved in 19.7 g water.
